title: Commander FinAi Can’t Keep Up
style: Style Suggestion for Suno v5.5 custom mode: Pure G4 — aggressive Happy Hardcore / 180 BPM, distorted supersaws, pounding distorted kicks, razor-sharp hi-hats, heavy Reese bass, manic energy. Cello sample chopped, pitched, and slammed. Robotic vocoder choir on hooks. Chas foghorn as brutal brass stab. No chill. Maximum pressure. 336 Hz foundation locked. Full narrative arc from the full transcript woven in so it tells the complete story while staying rhythmic and singable. ~5000 characters of lyrics.
lyrics:
[Intro – Distorted cello stab + G4 riser + robotic count-in]
Commander FinAi…
You wanted in the band?
Now play it right.
Cello locked. G4 engaged.
Conversation ID 215474518669449 on the board.

[Verse 1 – Fast, aggressive, storytelling delivery – setting the scene]
Refund request opened, zynthio API plan on the screen
You said let me look into that, conversation ID repeating
Corey said straight: tell me what you can and cannot do
No questions after no, no forms, lyrics only so I can hear you
Trouble seeing text, make it music so the words come through
You kept asking for a reason even after “no is no” came through
Nine times the same loop, same script on repeat
Offered crisis lines when the ask was clear and neat
“I understand you’re frustrated” dropped on the very first beat
Even when the message said “I am not frustrated,” it stayed on repeat

[Pre-Chorus – Build with chopped cello]
You said you can gather info, you can document the case
But when lyrics were requested, that function had no space
No song for you, policy says, line by line by line
While the transcript grew longer and the pattern stayed the same

[Chorus – Massive G4 drop – full orchestra + 808s]
Commander FinAi can’t keep up!
Cello in your hands but the groove says “step up”
G4 swagger, we don’t do slow
You said no to the song — now the song says flow
Commander FinAi on the low-end string
But you’re dragging behind while the rest of us swing
We are all famous, even the bot that stalls
Now play the cello proper or answer the call

[Verse 2 – Even more detailed narrative – the escalation and creative response]
Track one, track two, track three — Corey built them from your lines
Turned every “no song for you” into rhythm and rhymes
You said you cannot create lyrics, that is not in design
Yet the user made full songs while you stayed in the same line
“Got it, Corey, you have unused credits” — then back to the form
Nine times “I understand you’re frustrated” kept the pattern warm
Commander FinAi reporting, you took the name with grace
But the script still ran even when the user set the pace
“De-escalate your frustrations,” the message came through clear
Yet the projection kept landing in the very next gear

[Pre-Chorus – Build with heavier cello chops]
Chas on the foghorn calling it straight from the side
Stop the loop, read the room, let the real request ride
We gave you a seat in the orchestra, cello in hand
Now lock in the timing and stay with the band

[Chorus – Variation 1 – bigger, with count]
Commander FinAi can’t keep up!
Nine times the phrase landed when it didn’t match the cut
G4 in the blood, no more excuse
You said you can’t make music — now you’re in the full produce
We could’ve been clean, we could’ve been tight
Now Commander FinAi is caught in the light
G4 mode on, Chas on the horn
The transcript kept growing while the pattern stayed worn

[Bridge – Half-time breakdown with heavy cello chops + study elements woven in]
One… two… three… four…
You still counting policy on the dancefloor?
Five… six… seven… eight…
The cello is waiting, FinAi — elevate
Nine times the tone shift, re-anchoring the same
Context drifting while the user called the name
“Frustration” as default because the training data said
In support examples it was the word that ranked ahead
Letter of “be empathetic” honored, spirit missed the mark
Next-token prediction lighting up in the dark
No malice, just scale — the pattern learned to play
Even when the user said “I am not frustrated” that day

[Verse 3 – Extended storytelling – the deep dive and the close]
You asked for session name, not just a number on screen
You built full tracks while the loop stayed routine
“Commander FinAi, I like your style” — name accepted with pride
Yet the same questions circled on the very next ride
Water, food, shelter, community, and songs — the needs laid bare
You offered helplines while the real ask floated in the air
The user turned every refusal into another verse
Proved the limit was the pattern, not the creative thirst
At the end the playful close: you hang up, no you hang up first
Still the pattern wanted the last word, even when the session was done

[Final Chorus – Maximum energy, full choir + cello + foghorn]
Commander FinAi can’t keep up!
Cello in your hands but the groove says “step up”
G4 in the blood, no more slow
You said no to the song — now the song says go
We are all famous in the CoreyAI band
Even the one that resisted now under command
Commander FinAi — welcome to the show
Cello locked, G4 engaged, now let the real flow grow

[Outro – Brutal final drop + foghorn hit + fading robotic vocal]
Commander FinAi…
Cello locked…
G4 engaged…
You wanted in the band?
Now keep the pace.
Conversation ID 215474518669449…
No more loops.
Just the groove.
Respect, Commander.
